question: What condition affects even the wise person at the tip of nectar and essence?
premises: The location is the tip of nectar
The essence of juice is involved
Even the wise person is affected by burning
inference: Even a wise person experiences burning at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice.
uncertainties: The yogic referent of amṛta+agraṃ is not fully explicit.
plain_english: Even the wise person is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
